name: XSL Script Execution Via WMIC.EXE
description:
Detects the execution of WMIC with the "format" flag to potentially load XSL files.
Adversaries abuse this functionality to execute arbitrary files while potentially bypassing application whitelisting defenses.
Extensible Stylesheet Language (XSL) files are commonly used to describe the processing and rendering of data within XML files.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: WMIC.exe FP depend on scripts and administrative methods used in the monitored environment.
query: (process.executable:*\\wmic.exe AND process.command_line:(*\-format* OR *\/format* OR *–format* OR *—format* OR *―format*)) AND (NOT (process.command_line:(*Format\:List* OR *Format\:htable* OR *Format\:hform* OR *Format\:table* OR *Format\:mof* OR *Format\:value* OR *Format\:rawxml* OR *Format\:xml* OR *Format\:csv*)))
